scope: Sender server + client against a local HMAC-verified mock /exec

results.name: HMAC primitive matches the RFC 4231 test vector
envelope matches the Python tool construction byte-for-byte
response loss after save: retry keeps body/event_id and gets duplicate
sustained network failure: exactly 3 attempts, then unconfirmed
BUSY is retried on the same event and then accepted
STALE_SIGNATURE triggers a re-signed retry of the same event
HTML login page is never treated as success and is not retried
ingest key cannot confirm: FORBIDDEN_EVENT refused without retries
mismatched request_id in an ok:true response is refused
health reports configuration without leaking secrets
start sends a signed INCOMPLETE create with phone and exact consent
second start is idempotent and creates no second event
complete sends request.complete with expected_version and reaches SUBMITTED
double submit replays the stored result without a second event
no follow-up consent: single SUBMITTED create at the end
status uses request.get bound to the session only
unconfirmed create is settled by the same event before completing
VERSION_CONFLICT reads authoritative state then allows a fresh decision
validation rejects bad fields before any event is signed
past preferred time is rejected with a clear code
reset refuses while an event is unconfirmed
unknown origin is rejected; no-origin clients still work
rate limit returns 429 after the configured budget
static site is served from dist with SPA fallback; unknown API is 404
no API response ever contains the ingest secret
frontend never references VITE_-prefixed secrets
built bundle (when present) does not contain the ingest secret
